Malik said: 'When there is necessity, the religion of Allah is ease.'

hadiths.english_translation: It reached Malik that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ entered upon Umm Salamah while she was in mourning for Abu Salamah, and she had put aloe on her eyes. He said: 'What is this, O Umm Salamah?' She said: 'It is only aloe, O Messenger of Allah.' He said: 'Apply it at night and wipe it off during the day.' Malik said: 'Mourning for a young girl who has not yet reached menstruation is the same as for one who has reached menstruation. She avoids what a mature woman avoids when her husband dies.' Malik said: 'A slave woman mourns when her husband dies for two months and five nights, the same as her waiting period.' Malik said: 'There is no mourning for an umm walad when her master dies, nor for a slave woman when her master dies. Mourning is only for married women.'

hadiths.english_translation: Narrated from Al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from Aisha, the wife of the Prophet ﷺ, that a woman asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about washing from menstruation. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ instructed her how to wash, then said: 'Take a piece of cloth scented with musk and purify yourself with it.' She said: 'How should I purify myself with it, O Messenger of Allah?' He said: 'Purify yourself with it.' She said: 'How, O Messenger of Allah?' He said: 'Glory be to Allah! Purify yourself with it.' Aisha said: 'So I pulled her aside and said: Follow the traces of blood with it.'

hadiths.english_translation: Narrated from Urwah ibn al-Zubayr, from Aisha, the wife of the Prophet ﷺ, that Fatimah bint Abi Hubaysh came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said: 'O Messenger of Allah, I am a woman who has chronic bleeding (istihadah) and I do not become pure. Should I abandon the prayer?' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'No, that is only a vein, it is not menstruation. So when your menstruation comes, abandon the prayer, and when it goes, wash the blood from yourself and pray.'

hadiths.english_translation: Narrated from Sulayman ibn Yasar, from Umm Salamah, the wife of the Prophet ﷺ, that she said: 'When I was with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, I was lying down with him under a single covering when I got my menstruation. So I slipped away and took my menstrual clothes.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to me: 'Have you gotten your menstruation (nufist)?' I said: 'Yes.' So he called me and I lay down with him under the covering.'
